canDo: Say what I like and don't like
Name colours and my favourite things
grammar: be: I am / you are / it is

chunks.example: I like cats. I don't like eggs.

talkMissions.title: Meet Pip
talkMissions.goal: Child introduces self: name, age, and one thing they like. Pip shares the same about himself and asks one follow-up.
talkMissions.opener: Hello! I'm Pip. I'm a fox from planet Zoot. I'm new on Earth. What's your name?

talkMissions.title: Colours and favourite things
talkMissions.goal: Child names favourite colour, animal and food, and says one thing they don't like. Pip is surprised by Earth colours and asks what things are that colour.
talkMissions.opener: On Zoot, everything is purple! Is Earth purple too? What's your favourite colour?

talkMissions.title: My family
talkMissions.goal: Child talks about family members (who, name, one thing they like). Pip talks about his own fox family on Zoot.
talkMissions.opener: I have a big fox family on Zoot. My mum is very funny! Tell me about your family. Who is in your family?

letters.subject: Hello from Zoot!
letters.body:
Dear friend,
Hello! My name is Pip. I am a fox. I am ten years old. I am from planet Zoot. Zoot is very far. On Zoot, the sky is purple and the trees are pink! I like apples and I like drawing. I don't like rain. Now I am on Earth. I want to learn about your world. Can you help me?
Your new friend,
Pip 🦊
letters.replyPrompt: Tell Pip your name, your age and your favourite colour.
letters.replyPromptTr: Pip'e adını, yaşını ve en sevdiğin rengi yaz.

questions.q: What colour is the sky on Zoot?

letters.subject: What is this?
letters.body:
Dear friend,
Today I see a small animal. It is black and white. It says "meow"! What is it? I think it is a cat. On Zoot, we have no cats. I like cats! Do you like cats? What is your favourite animal?
Love,
Pip 🦊
letters.replyPrompt: Tell Pip your favourite animal. Do you like cats?
letters.replyPromptTr: Pip'e en sevdiğin hayvanı yaz. Kedileri sever misin?

letters.subject: My fox family
letters.body:
Dear friend,
This is my family. My mum's name is Lila. She is funny. My dad's name is Rok. He likes fish. I have a sister. Her name is Mimi. She is six. She likes pink! I miss my family. Tell me about your family, please.
Pip 🦊
letters.replyPrompt: Tell Pip about your family. Who is in your family? What do they like?
letters.replyPromptTr: Pip'e aileni anlat. Ailende kimler var? Neleri severler?

story.title: My home
story.prompt: Draw your home and the people and animals who live there.
story.promptTr: Evini ve orada yaşayan insanları, hayvanları çiz.

pages.prompt: Draw your home. What colour is it?
What do you like in your home?

explorer.title: Foxes
explorer.text: Foxes are small wild animals. They have red or orange fur and a big tail. Foxes have big ears. They can hear very well. Foxes live in forests, in fields and in some cities too! They sleep in the day and look for food at night. Foxes eat mice, insects and fruit.
facts: A fox's tail is very big.
Foxes look for food at night.

questions.q: When do foxes look for food?

explorer.title: Rainbow colours
explorer.text: A rainbow has seven colours: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet. You can see a rainbow when there is sun and rain at the same time. The sun shines through the rain drops. Then the light breaks into colours. You can make a small rainbow with water and a torch!

questions.q: How many colours has a rainbow got?
When can you see a rainbow?
Which colour is in a rainbow?

assessment.pictureTask: Look at the picture and tell Pip what you can see. What animals and colours can you see? What is the girl doing?
